name: Vector DB Writer
description: Persist vector points into a local FAISS-backed vector store and emit a reusable store handle.

parameters.name: backend
parameters.description: Vector store backend. Phase 1 uses local FAISS persistence.

parameters.name: index_name
parameters.description: Stable index folder name used under the selected storage directory.

parameters.name: storage_directory
parameters.description: Optional local destination directory. Defaults to ParaGraph/resources/artifacts/vectorstores when omitted.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Similarity metric for search and indexing.

parameters.name: write_mode
parameters.description: Overwrite or append to an existing local store.

parameters.name: nlist
parameters.description: FAISS IVF list count. Used when index_type is ivf_flat.

parameters.name: hnsw_m
parameters.description: FAISS HNSW graph connectivity. Used when index_type is hnsw_flat.
